caption:
The Look Comes First

Every session begins with one question:
what look would you like today?

So much makeup advice focuses on the face alone —
skin tone, texture, the shape of the eyes,
the height of the nose, contour and structure.
But you do not live as a face alone.
Shape and colour matter, of course,
yet makeup is only one part
of the mood you carry as a whole.

So I begin with your look —
your clothes, your hair.
Where the blush goes, which eyeshadow and how,
all of it follows from there.
The look comes first.

What style do you love?
And what style is truly you?
Effortless, casual, sophisticated,
feminine, natural, sensual.

What look will you begin your day with?
